subject: Request: SIG questionnaire control mapping & evidence intake — CadenceBank RFI
messages:
From: Leah Martin <leah.martin@cadencebank.com>
To: grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: CadenceBank Procurement <procurement@cadencebank.com>
Date: Fri, 25 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CadenceBank RFI: SIG Questionnaire (v3)

Grace —

Thanks for taking this. Attached is CadenceBank's SIG questionnaire (v3) and a short intake checklist. Our security review is on a tight schedule and we need: an initial control mapping (SIG->Redwood control IDs), representative evidence for high-risk controls, and a proposed delivery cadence.

Key asks up front:
- Control mapping CSV by 5 business days
- Evidence bundle (sample artifacts) for the top 25 high-risk controls within 10 business days
- A contact list for evidence collectors and a preferred SFTP/Drive path

We're flexible on exact artifact formats (PDF, zipped logs, or links to evidence) but prefer a single intake spreadsheet that maps controls to artifacts and owners.

Attached: Cadence_SIG_QUESTIONNAIRE_v3.pdf

Leah Martin
Sr. Vendor Risk Manager
CadenceBank
From: grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Leah Martin <leah.martin@cadencebank.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 25 May 2028 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CadenceBank RFI: SIG Questionnaire (v3)

Leah —

Thanks for the questionnaire and the clear asks. We'll run an intake sprint and deliver a control crosswalk + a representative evidence packet per your timeline. Proposed plan below: 

1) Intake kickoff (today): confirm owners & toolchain — grace, karthik, marissa to own delivery.
2) Crosswalk template: we will use a single workbook ("redwood-control-crosswalk.xlsx") with tabs: SIG-Controls, Redwood-Control-IDs, Evidence-Links, Owner-Roster. Delivery: 3 business days.
3) Evidence sprint: collectors pull representative artifacts for top 25 high-risk controls. Delivery: 10 business days for bundle; incremental early handoffs encouraged.
4) Secure transfer: we'll provide an S3 pre-signed path; if Cadence prefers Drive, we'll mirror.

Sample mapping snippet (for clarity):
- SIG Control: ORG-01 (Access Management) -> Redwood Control ID: R-INF-AC-02 -> Evidence: role-based IAM policy screenshots, access review export (CSV), change log (zip)

Attachments: redwood-control-crosswalk.xlsx (draft)

Can you confirm that the 10-business-day window for the evidence bundle works for you? Also, please share any vendor constraints (e.g., proof redaction rules, approved redaction tool).

Thanks —
Grace O'Connor
Manager, Trust & Assurance
Redwood Inference
From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: olga_petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 25 May 2028 11:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CadenceBank RFI: SIG Questionnaire (v3) — collectors + evidence format

Grace / team —

Acknowledged. I'll own the collector coordination and the S3 intake automation. Notes and constraints:
- We'll ask collectors (engineering, infra, platform security) to gather artifacts in the following normalized formats:
  * Screenshots / PDFs for configuration evidence
  * CSV exports for audit logs (>= 90 days where available)
  * Plain text exports for IAM role bindings and policy diffs
  * Zips for multi-file logs with README.txt describing timeframe
- We'll place artifacts in s3://redwood-evidence/cadencebank/DEAL-2028-0892/ and provide pre-signed URLs. If Cadence requires Drive-only, we will sync to the Drive link in your email.
- I'll prepare a small checklist for collectors to ensure artifacts include provenance (who, when, what) and minimal redaction guidance.

I attached a one-page collector checklist (attachment stub: collector-checklist.pdf) and the initial crosswalk. Planning to run a 2-hr evidence walkthrough session next Tue to align collectors and cadence.

Karthik
Principal, Compliance Engineering
Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: olga_petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 25 May 2028 13:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CadenceBank RFI: SIG Questionnaire (v3) — timeline check

All —

Quick status: legal has one small note around sharing live telemetry (they want a redaction stub and a limited-scope access token). I'll coordinate with Olga to prepare the redaction template and legal checklist. That should not impact the 10-business-day target if collectors start today.

Action items I own:
- Confirm artifact delivery windows per owner (by EOD Monday)
- Produce the redaction template and legal checklist (Olga and I)
- Prepare a short summary packet we can hand to Leah after the first tranche (top 10 controls)

Marissa Cole
Senior Manager, Trust Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Leah Martin <leah.martin@cadencebank.com>
To: grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@cadencebank.com
Date: Sat, 26 May 2028 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CadenceBank RFI: SIG Questionnaire (v3) — acceptance of plan

Grace / team —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the clear plan. The proposed timelines look good; we appreciate the pre-signed S3 option (preferred). Two follow-ups: 
1) Please include a representative sample of key rotation proof (KMS policy + key rotation log) in the top-10 tranche.
2) For artifacts that contain IP or customer data, we require a short statement of redaction performed and the tool used. A one-line provenance statement per artifact is sufficient.

I'll circulate an internal resource list for reviewers and confirm an initial 90-minute kickoff slot for next Tue.

Regards —
Leah
Sr. Vendor Risk Manager
CadenceBank
